invariants.rationale: The method returns the local map field, which is expected to be a valid TiledMap instance.
If parameter was non-null, it was used to call setTextureFilters, which likely expects non-null filter values.
The file is required to load a TiledMap, so it should not be null at method exit.
An AssetManager is required for loading assets and should not be null here.
The fileName should be non-null and non-empty to identify the map resource.
